item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "69cbeb67c82f24226fdbf3df9959f3e127b28272b7f7094d9e2c935db3586c54",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "For a real normed vector space E, a function q : ℝ → ℝ → E satisfies LocalDef004 at every real spatial coordinate x and time t.",
      "effect_on_target": "The differentiability implication asserts existence of both partial derivatives and the transport equation at every point.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "For q and flux, every spatial slice of q is interval integrable, every time slice of flux composed with q is interval integrable, and for all a,b,s,t the spatial integral at t minus that at s equals the time integral from s to t of flux(q(a,τ)) minus flux(q(b,τ)).",
      "effect_on_target": "The last implication asserts all three properties for q(x,t)=profile(x−speed·t) and flux(z)=speed·z.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "Given profile and speed, defines q(x,t)=profile(x−speed·t).",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the function throughout the proposition; q is not an arbitrary or existentially chosen solution.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "At a specified (x,t), there exist qt and qx in E such that τ↦q(x,τ) has derivative qt at t, ξ↦q(ξ,t) has derivative qx at x, and qt+speed•qx=0.",
      "effect_on_target": "For E=ℝ, encodes actual existence of the two partial derivatives and their equation qt+speed·qx=0. Witnesses may depend on the point and the given function and speed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "LocalDef005",
      "meaning": "Scalar multiplication is continuous on every real normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies a structural prerequisite for derivative predicates in the local definitions; adds no assumption on profile.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Retains the addition, zero, and commutative monoid laws of an additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the additive monoid structure underlying real scalar actions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Projects the additive group structure from an additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves ordinary real addition and additive inverses in structural instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "AddGroup.toSubNegMonoid",
      "meaning": "Projects addition, subtraction, and negation structure from an additive group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the inherited operations used in the real algebraic structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "AddMonoid.toAddZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Retains addition and its two-sided zero identity from an additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides zero-compatible addition for structural scalar-action instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "AddZero.toZero",
      "meaning": "Projects the zero element from an addition-with-zero structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the inherited real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "AddZeroClass.toAddZero",
      "meaning": "Projects addition and zero from a structure asserting the additive identity laws.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the real additive structure to its zero element.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction: both propositions hold.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires all five outer claims, all three conservation properties, and all conditions on derivative witnesses.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "A densely normed field inherits a nontrivial normed field structure with the same underlying normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar-field prerequisite for differentiation over ℝ.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "Differentiable",
      "meaning": "A function is differentiable over the specified scalar field at every point of its domain.",
      "effect_on_target": "Only the fourth conjunct assumes that profile is real differentiable everywhere; continuity of its derivative is not required.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul",
      "meaning": "Retains scalar multiplication preserving zero and addition from a distributive multiplicative action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the ordinary real scalar action used by differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "DistribSMul.toSMulZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Projects a scalar action preserving zero from a distributive scalar action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies structural scalar-action data without restricting profile.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "DivisionSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Projects the underlying semiring from a division semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real semiring operations in the module instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "All displayed equalities are exact, including pointwise initial and characteristic identities and integral balance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "Field.toSemifield",
      "meaning": "Retains the semifield operations and laws of a field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited real algebraic structures; introduces no positivity or nonzero restriction on speed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "HAdd.hAdd",
      "meaning": "Projects the addition operation from the supplied heterogeneous addition instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "With the displayed real instances, forms x+speed·t and sums of real derivative values.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "HMul.hMul",
      "meaning": "Projects multiplication from the supplied heterogeneous multiplication instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "With real instances, gives ordinary multiplication in speed·t and flux(state)=speed·state.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "The function has the specified derivative at the specified point, using the neighborhood-based derivative filter with that point fixed.",
      "effect_on_target": "Asserts actual derivatives at unrestricted real points, both along characteristics and for the partial derivatives in LocalDef004.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "Projects the normed vector space structure from an inner product space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real normed vector space structure on the scalar-valued target.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "IntervalIntegrable",
      "meaning": "Integrability on both half-open intervals (a,b] and (b,a] with respect to the chosen measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes integrability independent of endpoint ordering; the last hypothesis requires this for profile for every pair of real endpoints.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "IsModuleTopology.toContinuousSMul",
      "meaning": "A module topology makes the scalar action continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuity of real scalar multiplication needed by HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "IsTopologicalRing.toIsTopologicalSemiring",
      "meaning": "The continuity properties of a topological ring supply those of a topological semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the construction of continuous real scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "IsTopologicalSemiring.toIsModuleTopology",
      "meaning": "A topological semiring acting on itself has the corresponding module topology.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the real ring topology with the scalar-action continuity instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume",
      "meaning": "Projects the distinguished measure from the supplied measure-space structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Every integral and integrability condition uses the same distinguished measure on ℝ.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Projects the distributive scalar action from a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar action of ℝ on itself.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "MonoidWithZero.toMonoid",
      "meaning": "Projects the multiplicative monoid structure from a monoid with zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the multiplicative structure underlying the scalar action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the operations and commutativity while forgetting the associativity requirement in a nonunital commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an inherited real ring structure for topological instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "meaning": "Projects the nonunital nonassociative ring structure, forgetting its commutativity requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the ring structure required by the real topological-ring instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the algebraic nonunital commutative ring structure of a normed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real topological-ring instance chain with unchanged operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Projects a nonunital seminormed ring structure from its commutative version.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports construction of the additive seminormed structure used in real differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive commutative group, and compatible pseudometric from a nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the additive analytic structure on ℝ.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Projects the normed field from a nontrivially normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real norm and field operations used in the analytic instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toNormedAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive group, and metric while forgetting the commutativity requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real normed additive structure used to build the integrability norm.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive group, and pseudometric of a normed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real normed-space instance in the local predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "NormedAddGroup.toENormedAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Equips a normed additive group with the corresponding extended nonnegative norm and additive monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the interval-integrability condition use the ordinary real norm viewed as an extended norm.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the normed commutative ring operations and metric while forgetting the unit requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies a structural ancestor of the real topological-ring data.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the ring, norm, and compatible pseudometric from a normed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the ordinary analytic structure on ℝ in several instance chains.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "NormedField.toField",
      "meaning": "Projects the field structure from a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies ordinary real field algebra for scalar-action instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the normed commutative ring structure of a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the compatible real ring and metric structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Projects the module structure from a normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real vector-space operations in the derivative predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number numeral using the supplied numeral instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets the displayed numeral 0 as real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Projects the uniform structure associated with a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the uniform structure inducing the topology used in real differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal",
      "meaning": "Builds a real inner product space on an RCLike field using its real inner product and normed algebra structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Specialized to ℝ, provides its usual real normed vector space structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The type of real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "All coordinates, times, speeds, profile values, flux values, and derivative witnesses are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "The real normed field has elements with norms between any two prescribed strictly ordered positive bounds.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the standard nontrivially normed scalar field used for differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "Real.instAdd",
      "meaning": "Installs real addition as the addition operation on ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines addition in characteristic coordinates and real sums.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Provides the additive commutative group structure on ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports addition, subtraction, zero, and the additive structures used in calculus.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "Real.instMul",
      "meaning": "Installs real multiplication as the multiplication operation on ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines speed times time and the linear flux.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "Real.instRCLike",
      "meaning": "Equips ℝ with an RCLike structure having real part the identity, imaginary part zero, distinguished I zero, and its real normed algebra and complete-space structures.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies analytic instances on ℝ; does not introduce complex-valued variables.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "Installs the real zero element.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the initial time and the claimed zero derivative.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "Real.measureSpace",
      "meaning": "Provides the selected measure-space structure on ℝ through an inferred instance; the displayed body does not expand that instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the measure μ used in all interval integrals and integrability assumptions. Its identification and normalization are not exposed by this body.",
      "status": "unclear"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "Real.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Combines the real norm, additive commutative group, and compatible real metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real-valued analytic structure for the local definitions and integration.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Combines real commutative ring operations with the real norm and compatible metric, including the norm multiplication bound.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the compatible ring and norm structures in the explicit type.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "Combines the real field operations with the real norm and metric, with multiplicativity of the norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the scalar field for real differentiation and normed vector spaces.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The real pseudometric has distance d(x,y)=|x−y|, with its associated uniform structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the usual real topology for neighborhoods and derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "Real.semiring",
      "meaning": "Provides the semiring structure of ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the self-module topology construction for real scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "SMulZeroClass.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Projects scalar multiplication from a scalar action preserving zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar multiplication operation required by its continuity instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "Semifield.toDivisionSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains division-semiring operations and laws from a semifield.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies inherited real algebraic structures without adding hypotheses.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the seminorm, pseudometric, and nonunital commutative ring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the additive seminormed structure used for real calculus.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Projects the seminormed ring structure from its commutative version.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies an inherited real pseudometric instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "SeminormedRing.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Projects the compatible pseudometric space from a seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the metric-based topology in the explicit real instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "Semiring.toMonoidWithZero",
      "meaning": "Retains multiplication, one, zero, and their monoid-with-zero laws from a semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the scalar-action monoid structure on ℝ.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "SubNegMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Projects the additive monoid structure from a subtraction-and-negation monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies inherited real addition and zero for module instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Projects the topology belonging to a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the usual real topology for differentiability and integrability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Interprets the numeral 0 as the supplied zero element.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the initial time and characteristic derivative literal real zeros.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "instHAdd",
      "meaning": "Uses ordinary addition to define the homogeneous case of heterogeneous addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves the displayed addition notation to real addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "instHMul",
      "meaning": "Uses ordinary multiplication to define the homogeneous case of heterogeneous multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves the displayed products to real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "instIsTopologicalRingReal",
      "meaning": "The real ring is a topological ring: its ring operations have the required continuity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides structural continuity needed for the real scalar-action instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "HSub.hSub",
      "meaning": "Projects subtraction from the supplied heterogeneous subtraction instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms the translated argument, differences of spatial integrals, and boundary-flux difference.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "An additive commutative group equipped with a norm and its compatible metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Is a structural parameter of the generic local definitions, instantiated by ℝ in the target.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "NormedAddGroup.toAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Projects the additive group from a normed additive group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides subtraction and additive algebra for the interval integral.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "NormedSpace",
      "meaning": "A vector-space structure over a normed field compatible with the given seminorm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real scalar multiplication for the generic local predicates and integrals; the target specializes the value space to ℝ.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "Real.instSub",
      "meaning": "Real subtraction is defined by a−b=a+(−b).",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the sign in q(x,t)=profile(x−speed·t).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "SeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Projects the compatible pseudometric of a seminormed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the topology for the generic local analytic predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D079",
      "name": "SubNegMonoid.toSub",
      "meaning": "Projects subtraction from a subtraction-and-negation monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies subtraction of integral and flux values.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D080",
      "name": "instHSub",
      "meaning": "Uses ordinary subtraction to define homogeneous heterogeneous subtraction.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves all subtraction notation to the inherited subtraction operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D081",
      "name": "intervalIntegral",
      "meaning": "The oriented integral from a to b is the integral over (a,b] minus the integral over (b,a], each using the restricted specified measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the conservation identity meaningful for every ordering of a,b and s,t, with reversed limits changing signs.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D082",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toDivisionAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Builds a SubtractionCommMonoid from an additive commutative group, retaining subtraction and negation with their laws; it introduces no numerical division operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the inherited zero and subtraction structures in the local derivative equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D083",
      "name": "AddCommMagma.toAdd",
      "meaning": "Projects addition from a commutative additive magma.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the addition used in the local equation through the structural hierarchy.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D084",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddCommSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Retains associative commutative addition from an additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports inherited addition in the local definitions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D085",
      "name": "AddCommSemigroup.toAddCommMagma",
      "meaning": "Retains addition and commutativity from an additive commutative semigroup.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the addition operation through the instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D086",
      "name": "ENormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Retains the extended seminormed additive commutative monoid structure of an extended normed one.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the norm and addition structures used in integrability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D087",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toAddCommMonoid",
